item.text:
Audited all 34 verse positions in the [selected lyric](src/data/lyrics/baba-ko-hai-rone-oali-aik-sakina-ak-zehra.md). The Roman now follows the Urdu opening and seven stanzas. I corrected supported phonetic spellings, removed recitation counts and Roman-only framing repeats, and preserved the Urdu body and metadata.

Five existing Roman readings still need editorial sign-off where the Urdu differs or is fragmentary: the *jakra*, *Fidak*, *roze*, *Karb-e-Zahra*, and *Qamar* lines.
